title: Learning Higher-Order Interactions from Incomplete Spatiotemporal Data with Mixtures of Hypergraph Laplacians
abstract: arXiv:2605.17316v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Traffic sensor data exhibit strong temporal and cross-sensor dependencies, yet long gaps erase both a sensor's local history and the joint observations needed to learn its relationships with other sensors. We introduce MoHL, a mixture of hypergraph Laplacians that learns group-wise relational structure directly from incomplete spatiotemporal data. MoHL discovers overlapping sensor groups from observed co-variation, constructs a Laplacian component for each interaction order, and learns their mixture through holdouts that mimic the missingness pattern. By sharing weights across group-induced couplings, MoHL pools scattered evidence instead of estimating each coupling independently. We characterize the induced weight-sharing structure and analyze the conditions under which sharing reduces estimation risk. translated_title: 基于超图拉普拉斯混合模型从不完整时空数据中学习高阶交互
translated_abstract: 交通传感器数据表现出强烈的时序和跨传感器依赖性，然而长时段的缺失既抹去了传感器的局部历史，也抹去了学习其与其他传感器关系所需的联合观测。我们提出了MoHL，一种超图拉普拉斯混合模型，能够直接从不完整的时空数据中学习分组关系结构。MoHL从观测到的共变现象中发现重叠的传感器分组，为每个交互阶数构建一个拉普拉斯分量，并通过模拟缺失模式的留出样本学习它们的混合。通过在分组诱导的耦合之间共享权重，MoHL汇集了分散的证据，而不是独立估计每个耦合。我们刻画了由此产生的权重共享结构，并分析了共享在何种条件下能够降低估计风险。在三个交通网络上的实验表明，高阶分组在长时段缺失情况下最为有益，而支持匹配……
tldr: 提出MoHL超图拉普拉斯混合模型，可直接从不完整的时空数据中学习高阶分组交互结构，通过权重共享汇集分散证据，在长时段数据缺失的交通网络场景中最为有效。
en_tdlr: MoHL, a mixture of hypergraph Laplacians, learns higher-order group-wise interaction structures directly from incomplete spatiotemporal data by pooling scattered evidence through weight sharing, proving most effective under long gaps in traffic networks.
